interpretation.loss_minutes: Negative two-arm contrasts favor the positive-weight arm.
interpretation.clean_detection: Positive two-arm contrasts favor the positive-weight arm.
interpretation.normal_alarm_and_pre_alarm: Negative two-arm contrasts mean fewer alarms in the positive-weight arm.
interpretation.interaction: A difference of recording contrasts; its sign is endpoint-dependent. It is not a causal fraction.
interpretation.binary_pair_counts: Positive arm is the +1 arm; negative arm is the -1 arm. Empty for four-arm interactions.
